channel.title: Eat Safe Japan — allergies
channel.description: Gluten-free, vegan, halal and allergy-friendly eating in Japan — explained by locals.

item.title: Shellfish Allergy in Japan: What to Really Watch For
item.description: Travelling to Japan with a shellfish allergy? Shrimp (ebi) and crab (kani) are two of the nine mandatory allergens, but mollusks like squid, octopus and scallops are not labelled at all. Learn where shellfish hides in dashi, sauces and fried food, plus the exact Japanese phrases to use when ordering.

item.title: Nut Allergy Travel Guide for Japan
item.description: Planning a Japan trip with a peanut or tree nut allergy? Learn how Japanese allergen labelling actually works, which dishes commonly hide peanuts, walnuts or cashews, and the exact Japanese phrases to use so kitchen staff understand how serious your allergy is.

item.title: How to Read Japanese Food Allergy Labels
item.description: Travelling to Japan with a food allergy? Learn which allergens are legally required on packaged food, which are only 'recommended,' how to spot the kanji for egg, milk, wheat, buckwheat, peanut, shrimp, crab and walnut, and why restaurant menus don't have to tell you anything at all.
